fullContent:
Vaishvanara Churna 
 Reference: Chakradatta Amavata Chikitsa 15-18, Sahasrayoga, Astangahridayam. 
 In Sanskrit, Vaishvanara means fire. This Ayurvedic medicine is meant to correct digestive fire (agni) in the body. Vaishvanara Churna is an Ayurvedic medicine available in herbal powder form. Use of this herbal powder is quite effective to treat the various health issues like rheumatoid arthritis, constipation and diseases of the digestive tract. It pacifies the vata and kapha doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Saindhava lavana – Rock salt – 20 grams 
 Yavani – Trachyspermum ammi – 20 grams 
 Ajamoda – Trachyspermum roxburghianum – 30 grams 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale – 50 grams 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula – 120 grams 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the above mentioned ingredients, and make fine powder. Mixed well to make Vaishvanara Churna. 
 Dosage 
 
 1-3 grams once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by your physician. 
 In rheumatoid arthritis, it is given along with buttermilk or hot water. 
 For people having a sensitive stomach, it is given with ghee, to improve digestion. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Constipation 
 Abdominal pain 
 Bloating 
 Improves digestion 
 Strength and immunity 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Over dosage of this herbal powder may lead to diarrhea. 
 People with hypertension should take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
